build_sinusoidal_positional_embeddings: build sinusoidal positional embeddings of any length for a given embedding dimension and padding index
create_get_embedding_static: create sinusoidal embeddings matching the tensor2tensor implementation for a specified number of embeddings and dimension
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding with input of size batch by sequence length
test_incremental_decoding: test incremental state decoding with a specified timestep for single-step position embedding lookup
prepare_onnx_export: prepare the SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding module for ONNX export by enabling onnx_trace mode
